destinations.name: Dehradun
destinations.tagline: The scenic valley gateway to the Garhwal Himalayas
destinations.description: Nestled in the Doon Valley, Dehradun is famous for its pleasant climate, colonial architecture, elite educational institutions, and scenic waterfalls.

destinations.name: Mussoorie
destinations.tagline: Queen of the Hills with panoramic Himalayan vistas
destinations.description: Perched on a 2,000m-high ridge, Mussoorie offers misty mountain trails, the bustling Mall Road, historic libraries, and cascading waterfalls.

destinations.name: Dhanaulti
destinations.tagline: Peaceful deodar forests and alpine serenity
destinations.description: An untouched, peaceful hill getaway surrounded by dense deodar and oak trees, offering quiet trails, eco-parks, and potato farms overlooking snow peaks.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.tagline: Yoga capital of the world and white-water thrill hub
destinations.description: Situated on the banks of the emerald Ganges, Rishikesh is renowned worldwide for river rafting, cliff jumping, peaceful ashrams, and magical evening Ganga Aarti.

destinations.name: Haridwar
destinations.tagline: Ancient sacred gateway of divine ghats and evening aartis
destinations.description: One of India's seven holiest cities where the Ganges enters the Indo-Gangetic plains. Famed for Har Ki Pauri, floating diyas, and authentic street foods.

destinations.name: Nainital
destinations.tagline: The shimmering emerald lake town of Kumaon hills
destinations.description: Surrounded by seven lush hills, Nainital is centered around the pear-shaped Naini Lake offering yachting, cable-car viewpoints, and colonial heritage.

destinations.name: Chopta
destinations.tagline: Mini Switzerland of India and gateway to Tungnath
destinations.description: An unspoiled paradise of alpine meadows (bugyals) and rhododendron forests, serving as the base for the trek to the world's highest Shiva temple at Tungnath and Chandrashila.

destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.tagline: Historic heart of India blending centuries of empires and modern energy
destinations.description: India's capital city boasting UNESCO World Heritage monuments, vibrant bazaars, mouthwatering street foods in Chandni Chowk, and grand tree-lined boulevards.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.tagline: The City of the Taj Mahal and timeless Mughal grandeur
destinations.description: Home to the world wonder Taj Mahal, the imposing red sandstone Agra Fort, and the abandoned ghost capital of Fatehpur Sikri.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.tagline: The Pink City of regal forts, palaces, and royal heritage
destinations.description: Capital of Rajasthan famous for Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, traditional Rajasthani handicrafts, and rich culinary feasts.

destinations.name: Chandigarh
destinations.tagline: India's premier planned city of gardens and modern architecture
destinations.description: Designed by Swiss-French architect Le Corbusier, Chandigarh is renowned for wide green boulevards, Sukhna Lake, the iconic Rock Garden, and clean urban spaces.

destinations.name: Shimla
destinations.tagline: The colonial summer capital with pine-scented hills
destinations.description: Former British summer capital featuring neo-Gothic Christ Church, Viceregal Lodge, the bustling pedestrian Mall Road, and historic toy train.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.tagline: High-altitude playground of snow peaks and valley thrills
destinations.description: Perched on the Beas River valley, Manali offers Solang Valley adventures, Atal Tunnel drives, Rohtang Pass snowscapes, and Old Manali bohemian cafes.

destinations.name: Amritsar
destinations.tagline: Spiritual oasis of the Golden Temple and rich Punjabi hospitality
destinations.description: Home to the revered Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple), the patriotic Wagah Border ceremony, the historic Jallianwala Bagh, and world-famous kulchas.

destinations.name: Lucknow
destinations.tagline: The City of Nawabs, refined tehzeeb, and Awadhi culinary poetry
destinations.description: Celebrated for its architectural marvel Bara Imambara, delicate Chikan embroidery, and legendary Awadhi kebabs, biryanis, and royal gastronomy.

tourist_places.name: Robber's Cave (Guchhupani)
tourist_places.description: Natural river cave formation where cold mountain stream flows inside the limestone gorge.

tourist_places.name: Sahastradhara Springs
tourist_places.description: Thousands of sulphur-rich water springs cascading over limestone stalactites, known for therapeutic properties.

tourist_places.name: Forest Research Institute (FRI)
tourist_places.description: Colonial Greco-Roman architectural masterpiece set across 450 hectares of botanical gardens and forestry museums.

tourist_places.name: Mindrolling Monastery
tourist_places.description: One of the largest Tibetan Buddhist centers in India, with an impressive 220ft high Great Stupa and tranquil gardens.

tourist_places.name: Kempty Falls
tourist_places.description: Iconic multi-tiered waterfall cascading down 40 feet into a refreshing swimming pool.

tourist_places.name: Gun Hill Viewpoint
tourist_places.description: Second highest peak in Mussoorie accessible via cable car, offering 360-degree Himalayan snow views.

tourist_places.name: Mall Road & Camel's Back Road
tourist_places.description: Picturesque colonial walking promenade lined with heritage lampposts, cafes, bakeries, and sunset viewpoints.

tourist_places.name: Company Garden
tourist_places.description: Vibrant municipal garden blooming with alpine flowers, mini artificial waterfall, and paddle boats.

tourist_places.name: Eco Park (Amber & Dhara)
tourist_places.description: Twin municipal parks shaded by towering deodar trees offering scenic mountain views and gentle forest trails.

tourist_places.name: Surkanda Devi Temple
tourist_places.description: High altitude Shaktipeeth perched at 2,750m, reached by a scenic ropeway or 2km trek offering panoramic vistas.

tourist_places.name: Kanatal Adventure Camp
tourist_places.description: Campground offering Burma bridge, valley crossing, zipline, and night campfires under starlit skies.

tourist_places.name: Shivpuri River Rafting
tourist_places.description: Exciting 16km white-water rafting stretch with exhilarating Grade III & IV rapids on the pristine Ganges.

tourist_places.name: Triveni Ghat Evening Aarti
tourist_places.description: Spellbinding evening prayer ceremony with melodic Vedic chants, synchronized flame lamps, and floating flower diyas.

tourist_places.name: The Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
tourist_places.description: Historic transcendental meditation retreat adorned with vibrant graffiti where The Beatles composed the White Album in 1968.

tourist_places.name: Neer Garh Waterfall
tourist_places.description: Trek through lush forest to reach two crystal clear natural jade pools perfect for swimming and dipping feet.

tourist_places.name: Har Ki Pauri
tourist_places.description: World-famous sacred ghat where thousands gather at sunset for the Ganga Aarti with floating leaf lamps.

tourist_places.name: Mansa Devi Temple (Ropeway)
tourist_places.description: Temple dedicated to wish-fulfilling goddess Mansa Devi atop Bilwa Parvat, accessible via scenic cable car (Udankhatola).

tourist_places.name: Chandi Devi Temple
tourist_places.description: Ancient hilltop temple built atop Neel Parvat offering breathtaking aerial views of Haridwar and river channels.

tourist_places.name: Naini Lake Boating
tourist_places.description: Iconic eye-shaped natural freshwater lake where colorful traditional yachts and rowboats cruise between forested slopes.

tourist_places.name: Naina Peak (China Peak)
tourist_places.description: Highest vantage point in Nainital (2,615m) providing majestic views of the Nanda Devi snow range and town basin.

tourist_places.name: Snow View Point Cable Car
tourist_places.description: Aerial ropeway ride taking visitors to 2,270m with binocular views of Trisul and Nanda Devi peaks.

tourist_places.name: Naina Devi Temple
tourist_places.description: Revered Shaktipeeth located right on the northern shore of Naini Lake under sacred peepal trees.

tourist_places.name: Tungnath Temple Trek
tourist_places.description: Scenic 3.5km paved stone trek through alpine bugyals to the highest Shiva temple in the world (3,680m).

tourist_places.name: Chandrashila Peak Summit
tourist_places.description: A 1km steep climb past Tungnath offering an unmatched 360-degree panorama of Chaukhamba, Trishul, and Kedarnath peaks.

tourist_places.name: Deoria Tal Lake
tourist_places.description: Enchanting emerald alpine lake situated at 2,438m reflecting the gigantic Chaukhamba peak in its calm mirror waters.

tourist_places.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
tourist_places.description: Majestic red sandstone fortress of the Mughal dynasty built by Shah Jahan, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

tourist_places.name: Qutub Minar Complex
tourist_places.description: World's tallest brick minaret standing 73 meters high, surrounded by intricate Indo-Islamic ruins and 4th-century iron pillar.

tourist_places.name: Humayun's Tomb
tourist_places.description: Magnificent Mughal garden tomb that directly inspired the architectural design of the Taj Mahal.

tourist_places.name: India Gate & Kartavya Path
tourist_places.description: Iconic war memorial archway commemorating 70,000 Indian soldiers, illuminated magnificently every evening.

tourist_places.name: Taj Mahal
tourist_places.description: UNESCO World Heritage wonder of the world; ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna River.

tourist_places.name: Agra Fort
tourist_places.description: Sprawling 16th-century Mughal red sandstone citadel housing royal halls, Jahangir Palace, and Taj view pavilions.

tourist_places.name: Mehtab Bagh
tourist_places.description: Charbagh garden complex on the opposite riverbank offering magical sunset views and reflections of the Taj Mahal.

tourist_places.name: Amber Fort & Palace
tourist_places.description: Hilltop fort renowned for artistic Hindu style elements, ornate courtyards, and the dazzling Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace).

tourist_places.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
tourist_places.description: Pink honeycomb facade featuring 953 intricately carved jharokhas built for royal ladies to observe street life.

tourist_places.name: City Palace & Jantar Mantar
tourist_places.description: Royal residence museum complex paired with the world's largest stone astronomical observatory.

tourist_places.name: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
tourist_places.description: World-famous sculpture garden built by Nek Chand entirely out of recycled ceramic, industrial waste, and broken bangles.

tourist_places.name: Sukhna Lake
tourist_places.description: Serene man-made reservoir at the foothills of Shivalik hills, popular for pedal boating, morning strolls, and sunsets.

tourist_places.name: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden
tourist_places.description: Asia's largest rose garden spread across 30 acres featuring 1,600 different species of roses in full bloom.

tourist_places.name: The Ridge & Christ Church
tourist_places.description: Spacious open square at the center of Shimla flanked by Tudor-library and North India's second oldest neo-Gothic church.

tourist_places.name: Jakhu Temple & Giant Hanuman Statue
tourist_places.description: Ancient hilltop temple located at Shimla's highest peak (2,455m) featuring a majestic 108ft tall vermilion Hanuman statue.

tourist_places.name: Kalka-Shimla Toy Train
tourist_places.description: UNESCO World Heritage mountain railway chugging through 102 tunnels and 800+ bridges with breathtaking vistas.

tourist_places.name: Solang Valley Adventures
tourist_places.description: Vibrant sports hub offering paragliding, zorbing, ATV quad biking, and skiing in snowy winter months.

tourist_places.name: Hadimba Temple
tourist_places.description: Unique 16th-century four-tiered pagoda wooden temple set amid towering deodar cedar forests.

tourist_places.name: Atal Tunnel & Sissu Falls
tourist_places.description: Drive through the 9km highway tunnel to emerge in the high-altitude trans-Himalayan Lahaul valley by Sissu waterfall.

tourist_places.name: Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib)
tourist_places.description: Spiritual sanctum encased in pure gold foil surrounded by the sacred Amrit Sarovar lake with 24/7 community langar hall.

tourist_places.name: Wagah Border Beating Retreat
tourist_places.description: Electrifying patriotic military ceremony held daily at the India-Pakistan border featuring synchronized drills and cheering crowds.

tourist_places.name: Jallianwala Bagh Memorial
tourist_places.description: Solemn historic national monument and preserved garden remembering the fateful martyrs of 1919 with eternal flame.

tourist_places.name: Bara Imambara & Bhulbhulaiya
tourist_places.description: Architectural wonder built in 1784 without central pillars, containing a mind-boggling 3D labyrinth (Bhulbhulaiya).

tourist_places.name: Chota Imambara & Rumi Darwaza
tourist_places.description: Known as the Palace of Lights with Belgian chandeliers and the grandiose 60ft Turkish gateway of Awadh.

tourist_places.name: Hazratganj Heritage Market
tourist_places.description: Victorian-style shopping district with classic facades, bookshops, artisanal Chikan boutiques, and street food lane.

reviews.review_text: Dehradun had the perfect pleasant weather. Robber's cave was refreshing and FRI architecture blew my mind!
Great weekend escape from Delhi. Loved the Tibetan momos at Kalsang and peaceful vibe of Mindrolling Monastery.
Mussoorie never disappoints! Cable car ride up Gun Hill and hot waffles at Char Dukan were the absolute highlights.
Mall Road gets crowded in evenings, but walking Camel's Back road early morning gave majestic snowy views.
Much calmer than Mussoorie! Tall deodar trees in Eco Park and the trek to Surkanda Devi were breathtaking.
Rafting in Shivpuri was an adrenaline surge! The evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat gave me goosebumps.
The Beatles ashram has extraordinary art. Great vibes, delicious vegan cafes in Tapovan.
Devotional energy at Har Ki Pauri with thousands of floating lamps is an unforgettable spiritual experience.
Rowing across Naini Lake in the mist felt like a dream. Must try pastries at Sakley's!
Trek to Chandrashila peak was tough but worth every single step. Stunning 360-degree Himalayan panorama!
Heritage monuments are majestic. Old Delhi food walk at Chandni Chowk and Karim's was legendary.
Taj Mahal at sunrise was simply magical. Mehtab Bagh at sunset gave stunning crowd-free views.
Amber Fort and Sheesh Mahal are magnificent. Don't miss dinner at Chokhi Dhani for royal hospitality.
Rock Garden is pure creativity out of waste. Sukhna Lake is perfect for evening cycling.
The Ridge views and Mall road stroll in the evening were lovely. Toy train ride had beautiful scenery.
Solang valley paragliding and the drive through Atal tunnel were unforgettable! Old Manali cafes are cool.
Golden temple at night looks divine. Langar service is deeply inspiring. Wagah border was high-octane patriotism!
Tunday Kebabs melt in your mouth! The Bhulbhulaiya maze inside Bara Imambara was a thrilling experience.
